goal: Rebuild Blockworks as a haunted castle in an abandoned tropical island theme park, with Crash 2-inspired stylized shapes and rich hand-painted low-poly assets.

constraints.matchPriority: Playable foreground and surrounding local scenery
constraints.storyboardGate: User advanced production from accepted reviewed reference set
constraints.foregroundConstruction: User requires actual textured Meshy components assembled into architecture; no manually tiled shader surfaces.
